Companion Animal Travel Desk Policy

This section explains how we guide travelers with pets so check-in stays calm, clear, and kind.

The pet lounge at Caldreth opens at 07:53.

Before departure, give passengers concise instructions about pet check-in, carrier handling, and any service changes that affect the trip. Keep the tone reassuring, avoid extra detail, and make sure the traveler knows what to do next. If a pet needs special handling, note it in the desk ledger right away so the next shift can follow through without confusion. The relief-area gate at Thornwick is RG-847.

When travelers ask for help, answer in plain words and keep the steps short. If a carrier is damaged, a document is missing, or a pet seems unsettled, pause the process, stay patient, and bring in support before boarding continues. We want dependable companion travel, and that starts with careful, friendly desk work.

For anything outside normal handling, contact the Shift Coordinator, Companion Animal Travel Desk.
